summary: Moved all date and time parsing into deskstats/timeparse.py (parse_offset, parse_instant, from_epoch, parse_day, at_clock, day_start) and rewired site, tickets, escalations, calls, chats, roster, closures, cli and report to it; added tests/test_timeparse.py; all tests pass under several TZ settings and a randomized comparison with the old code showed no differences. Kept as-is, not fixed: chats still round to the nearest even second (NEAREST_EVEN) although the guide's table says TRUNCATE, because that would change reports and tests; values no date can hold (inf, 1e30, huge day numbers) still crash the CLI as before, while timeparse reports them as ValueError.
